entities.summary: Ralph Goings was an American painter closely associated with the Photorealism movement of the late 1960s and early 1970s. He was best known for his highly detailed paintings of hamburger stands, pick-up trucks, and California banks, portrayed in a deliberately objective manner. Ralph Goings was a painters & sculptors from Corning (1928-05-09, Corning–2016-09-04). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
